# watchpoint_dashboard_folder (Resource)

A folder that groups custom dashboards in the portal. Folders nest one level deep. File a dashboard in it with `folder_id` on `watchpoint_dashboard`. Destroying the folder keeps its contents: dashboards move up to the parent folder and subfolders move to the root. Reads need `dashboards.read`, writes `dashboards.manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_dashboard_folder" "payments" {
  name = "Payments"
}

resource "watchpoint_dashboard_folder" "payments_oncall" {
  name      = "On-call views"
  parent_id = watchpoint_dashboard_folder.payments.id
}

resource "watchpoint_dashboard" "checkout" {
  name           = "Checkout health"
  folder_id      = watchpoint_dashboard_folder.payments_oncall.id
  owner_group_id = watchpoint_user_group.payments.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Folder name (128 characters max).

### Optional

- `parent_id` (String) Parent folder. Omit for a top-level folder. The parent must itself be top-level, and a folder that has subfolders cannot be nested.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Folder ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_dashboard_folder.payments df_001
```
